name: Sender
line: Email campaigns, lifecycle workflows and transactional API/SMTP.

free.text: Free for 2,500 subscribers and 15,000 emails per month

cells.api: Yes, REST API and SMTP relay

subs.math: 1,000 subscribers × 4 sends = 4,000 emails. This is within the 2,500 subscriber and 15,000 send limits. Branding is required.
5,000 subscribers × 4 sends = 20,000 emails. This is within the 60,000 monthly sends.
10,000 subscribers × 4 sends = 40,000 emails. This is within the 120,000 monthly sends.
50,000 subscribers × 4 sends = 200,000 emails. This is within the 600,000 monthly sends.

appmail.math: 3,000 app sends to 1,000 contacts. The Free plan allows 2,500 subscribers and 15,000 monthly sends.
10,000 app sends to 1,000 contacts. The Free plan allows 2,500 subscribers and 15,000 monthly sends.
50,000 app sends to 1,000 contacts. The 5,000-contact tier includes 60,000 monthly sends.
100,000 app sends to 1,000 contacts. The 10,000-contact tier includes 120,000 monthly sends.
